I just made some new GBrain evals that help prove that my retrieval-for-AI-agent open source layer is SOTA for reading memory back without LLM-in-loop

And I've also added evals for memory-save from agent transcript, which is the best way to enrich your brain

Receipts at https://t.co/D5yLqCfQBk
@garrytan Most people think agent memory = vector search. It isn't. The real challenge is deciding what deserves to survive and retrieving it at exactly the right moment.
@garrytan the eval set and the retrieval layer have the same author. what does gbrain score on a memory benchmark somebody else wrote?

@garrytan memory evals are the part everyone skips. most agent memory demos measure 'did it store' and never 'did it retrieve the right thing under a paraphrase'. and retrieval without llm-in-loop is the latency win: sub-100ms recall instead of a full model call per lookup
